name: PUNCH machine: 12 OPL2-style FM percussion models
description: One extra machine after Chord with 12 percussion FM engines on SHAPE (KIK, TOM, BNG, CNG, TAI, TIM, MAR, DJB, BLK, GNG, BUB, ZAP), built on the Yamaha OPL2. COLOR is the FM index, SWEEP steps the ratio (shown as 1:4, 1:3, 1:2, 2:3, 1:1 .. 9:1, 10X, 12X, 15X), CONTOUR moves the sound, PUNCH turns the chip's LFO on, DECAY and GATE as on Tone.
source: tools/machines/punch, package port of the standalone PUNCH machine

uses.why: COLOR shows the FM index, SHAPE the model names (KIK..ZAP) and SWEEP the ratio names (1:4..15X) instead of numbers; CONTOUR keeps the generic state
SWEEP steps through the ratio list one detent at a time (the value is the step's knob position), not one knob unit at a time

emulation.tool: none yet; the standalone PUNCH was measured in its source tree

unchanged: every track that does not use PUNCH

emulation.tool: tools/emu/test_punch.py in the real OS voice loop (Unicorn), on the composed alone build
